name: trader_inventory
summary: What each trader contact buys and sells: prices, stock and wanted counts, the conditions goods must meet, and how much of what you hold meets them. Lists 2 contacts. Read only.

help.text: The game rolls a trader's inventory when the contact appears, so this works before the trader is interrogated. Leave contact_id out for every contact. Each line: item or gas name, prefab, credits per unit, wanted or in stock, and the conditions a sold item or gas must meet (purity, moles per unit, temperature range).
help.keys: contacts [{reference_id, trader, display_name, shuttle, pad_size_tiles, contacted, buys, sells}].

have.summary: have and sellable on lines it buys.
have.text: have: units you hold that meet its conditions, not capped by wanted: the goods on the pad network's vending machines and in the card holder's inventory, as trader_sell takes them (a 'Box of ...' line counts only boxes whose contents it accepts; a gas line counts the pad network's gas in units). The pad is the one the contact is called to, or every pad's network for a contact not called yet; the card holder is credit_card_id's holder, else the player. sellable (the landed trader only): the trade window's own count at the moment; null for a contact not landed.

contact_id.description: One trader contact (trader_contacts); left out, every contact.

credit_card_id.description: The card whose holder's inventory counts toward have; default the player's.
